notes: Used main sitemap index https://www.liputan6.com/sitemap.xml which lists section sitemaps (news, bisnis, showbiz, etc.). Each sitemap is parsed (or recursed if it is a sitemapindex) and URLs with <lastmod> dates are filtered to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25. Polite_fetch handles all HTTP requests respecting robots.txt. Dedupe by URL, write TSV with URL and ISO date. Script prints per‑day counts; test fetch of sample article shows >1500 characters and matching date.
